ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with high-intensity (white/yellow) localized clusters. Estimated macro-level ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels is approximately 1:4.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels are concentrated at the central notch and lower lobe margins. Mid-tone grey mottled regions occupy the central-lateral segments of both lobes. High-intensity pixels form discrete circular clusters mapped heavily across the distal margins and trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark linear pixel disruptions (~1-2px width) with inconsistent orientations visible on the light-grey mottled background of the interior left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of raised calcareous barnacle clusters along distal margins and trailing edges. Circular depigmented white scars visible near the lower central axis.
